services.name: Fishing Seasons
services.desc: The sport fishing seasons in the San Juan Islands vary from year to year, so it’s best to talk to Jim personally to see what is available. Every season provides different opportunities for sport fishing in the San Juan Islands. Normally Blackmouth (juvenile king salmon) are the target in the winter months. Spring Chinook or King salmon are fished from July through September. Silvers (Coho salmon) arrive late July providing good sport fishing through October. Halibut season varies but it normally opens in April. Lingcod are fished May and June, and bottomfishing is open year-round. This is a great hands-on fishery with lots of action! services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Guests often see whales on our fishing trips but if you really want to watch whales we recommend a 4-6 hour dedicated whale watching trip. Many marine mammals play in the waters around the San Juans including Orcas, Humpbacks, Minke, and Gray whales, Dall’s and Harbor porpoises, seals, sea lions, and a large variety of sea birds. Taking this tour is a great way to see wildlife and the islands up close and personal. We will often stop at a boat-in only island upon request. This tour is also a photographer’s dream! We work closely with local whale watching companies to ensure the highest possible sighting success. It’s a great opportunity to get those once in a lifetime
